verification_report.summary: The proof is correct. At the limit stage omega_1, CLD Lemma 8.1.4(c) gives precisely the sheaf-theoretic local union. For a decreasing sequence, local compactness supplies one compact neighbourhood core; compactness gives a finite rank bound for each row on a neighbourhood containing that same core. The countable supremum of the row ranks is below omega_1, so all rows lie in one countable stage on one fixed open neighbourhood and their decreasing limit lies in the successor stage. This proves closure at omega_1. Minimality of Psh_X and the reverse inclusion from Lemma 8.1.4 then give Psh_{X,omega_1}=Psh_X. CLD Proposition 8.1.11 gives the corresponding CPsh identity. The exact CLD definitions, topology hypotheses, and cited formulas match the proof, and no fixed countable-rank or first-stage-collapse claim is made.
